description: DL2 labeled diagnostic telemetry fixture corpus (M36). Canonical telemetry-session CSVs grouped by link-health class (healthy/warning/failsafe/wiring/antenna). lat/lon are always blank; no identifiers anywhere. Expected findings use the rule-id vocabulary: lq-collapse, rssi-floor, snr-noise, packet-instability, tx-power-saturation.
